_comment: TUM RGB-D freiburg1_desk (handheld Kinect office desk sequence, 640x480,
~30 Hz, 613 RGB frames over 20.4 s). Second, non-Spot environment for the
image-only claims (isotropy/retrieval dissociation, Timkey, encoder table).
The glob points at rgb_seq/, a timestamp-sorted copy of rgb/ renamed to
frame_%06d.png. This is required, not cosmetic: FolderSequence derives
frame_idx from the FIRST integer in the filename, and TUM's native names
(1305031452.791720.png) make that the Unix-epoch SECOND, so ~30 frames
would share one frame_idx — corrupting the crop->frame join in
encoder_comparison and turning retrieval gaps into units of 1 s.
rgb_seq is built by sorting rgb/*.png on the float timestamp in the name.
name: tum_fr1_desk
